thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] sev3 - embed-indexer rebalance causing 502/503s - eu-west-1
alex.oncall: I'm on it. seeing a spike in 502/503 from embedder-indexer behind routing-proxy
priya: confirmed p95/p99 embeddings latency ~3x, several hosted batch jobs failing to Dedicated pools
alex.oncall: initiated controlled drain of primary shard; promoting embedder-v2-warm replica to active
ops-bot: runbook step executed: promoted embedder-v2-warm -> active; toggled routing flag rtb-eu-west-embedder
jordan: observing heap pressure and GC churn on indexer during rebalance. HPA didn't scale - minReplica capped
sasha: scaling indexer pods manually + increasing CPU/memory limits to relieve pressure
alex.oncall: temp mitigation: route high-throughput tenants to quantized-fallback-embedder to reduce load
priya: confirmed fallback routing for top-10 tenants; error rate and latency trending down
emily-pm: impact note: ~15m degraded embeddings for multiple medium-tier customers; some retries masked failures, CS opened tickets for affected accounts
alex.oncall: detection lag ~6m due to missing rebalance-specific synthetic. we should add a rebalance probe to synthetic suite
ops-bot: incident acknowledged; severity lowered to sev4 at 09:37 UTC after stabilization

--- Post-incident / Handoff ---
alex.oncall: Mitigation stable. summarizing follow-ups with owners + sizing. please ack and adjust estimates as needed

ACTION-101: per-tenant circuit-breaker + backpressure for embed ingestion
- owner: sasha
- estimate: M (3d)
- notes: fast-fail + exponential backoff, opt-out for Dedicated customers, metrics + alerting

ACTION-102: autoscaler/ HPA enhancements to allow transient burst above min during shard rebalance
- owner: jordan
- estimate: L (8d)
- notes: add "rebalance" signal, safety tests, e2e perf verification

ACTION-103: routing-service auto-fallback to quantized-embedder on sustained error spike
- owner: priya
- estimate: S (2d)
- notes: thresholding, cooldown, record fallback usage to Console metrics

ACTION-104: rebalance-start telemetry + dashboard tile and alert rule
- owner: devex (infra-monitoring)
- estimate: S (2d)
- notes: surface rebalance events, link to runbook and postmortem page

ACTION-105: synthetic canary that performs a tiny index+embed across shard boundaries every 1m
- owner: emily-pm
- estimate: S (2d)
- notes: fail -> page oncall and annotate incident timeline automatically

ACTION-106: postmortem doc + customer-facing summary draft
- owner: alex.oncall
- estimate: XS (1d)
- notes: clear timeline, RCA, mitigations, ETA for fixes

emily-pm: product asks for prioritization guidance. my read: ACTION-102 is Q2-critical; rest staged across sprints
jordan: agree ACTION-102 should be Q2 commitment. it addresses root scalability gap
sasha: ACTION-101 and ACTION-103 are high ROI and quick; target next sprint
priya: ACTION-104 and ACTION-106 are needed this sprint for detection & comms

alex.oncall: proposal -> Q2 commit: ACTION-102 (L). Next sprint: ACTION-101 (M), ACTION-103 (S), ACTION-104 (S). ACTION-105 scheduled across sprint cadence for DR drills. ACTION-106 completed within 24h
